# SodaTide (sodatide.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for SodaTide, a synbiotic dietary supplement capsule (30 vegetarian capsules per bottle) labelled Metabolic & Digestive Support and offered to support gut balance and digestive comfort.

## Key facts
- Named ingredients: Chicory Root Inulin, Potato Resistant Starch, Akkermansia muciniphila, Clostridium butyricum, Bifidobacterium infantis; amounts are on the bottle panel
- Directions: one capsule daily with water, ideally before the first meal
- Packs (USD): 2 bottles $79 each ($158 plus shipping); 3 bottles $69 each ($207, free shipping); 6 bottles $49 each ($294, free shipping); four bonus guides with 3 and 6 per the seller
- One-time purchase, no subscription; 60-day money-back guarantee, subject to the terms shown at checkout
- Not a treatment for any digestive condition; live strains are not suitable for everyone, so people with weakened immunity or illness should ask a doctor first
